description: Synthetic seller support knowledge for the Northwind Marketplace demo.

branches.branch_name: Tax ID does not match business name during registration
branches.agent_script: I understand the registration form is rejecting your tax ID. This usually happens when the legal business name differs from the name on the tax certificate. Let's check both together.
steps: Ask the caller to read out the legal business name exactly as printed on the tax certificate.
Compare it with the name entered on the registration form, including punctuation and suffixes such as 'Pvt' or 'LLC'.
If they differ, guide the caller to edit the business name field to match the certificate and resubmit.
If the names already match, ask the caller to clear the browser cache and retry validation once.
If validation still fails, collect a screenshot of the error and escalate.
branches.tagging: Seller → Seller Registration → Tax ID does not match business name during registration
branches.description: I understand the registration form is rejecting your tax ID. This usually happens when the legal business name differs from the name on the tax certificate. Let's check both together.

branches.agent_script: Verification links stay valid for 24 hours. I'll help you request a fresh link so you can finish activating the account.
steps: Confirm the email address the caller registered with.
Ask the caller to open the sign-in page and choose 'Resend verification email'.
Advise them to check spam or quarantine folders and to open the newest email only.
If no email arrives within 15 minutes, verify the address for typos in the admin view and correct it.
Escalate if the address is correct and emails are still not delivered.
branches.tagging: Seller → Seller Registration → Verification email link expired
branches.description: Verification links stay valid for 24 hours. I'll help you request a fresh link so you can finish activating the account.

branches.agent_script: New seller applications are reviewed within three business days. Let me check where yours is in the queue.
steps: Note the registration reference number from the caller.
Check how many business days have passed since submission.
If under three business days, explain the review timeline and set expectations.
If the application is flagged for missing documents, tell the caller which documents to upload.
If it is older than three business days with no flags, escalate for manual review.
branches.tagging: Seller → Seller Registration → Registration stuck in pending review
branches.description: New seller applications are reviewed within three business days. Let me check where yours is in the queue.

branches.agent_script: Sorry you're not receiving the login code. Most delays come from network filters or an outdated mobile number, so let's check both.
steps: Confirm the last four digits of the registered mobile number with the caller.
Ask the caller to wait 60 seconds and use 'Resend OTP' only once to avoid rate limits.
Check whether the number has do-not-disturb or promotional SMS blocking enabled.
Offer the email OTP option if the account has a verified email.
If the registered number is outdated, start the mobile number update process.
branches.tagging: Seller → Login & OTP → Login code SMS not arriving
branches.description: Sorry you're not receiving the login code. Most delays come from network filters or an outdated mobile number, so let's check both.

branches.branch_name: Account locked after failed login attempts
branches.agent_script: For security, accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you get back in safely.
steps: Tell the caller how long remains on the 30-minute lock.
Recommend resetting the password instead of guessing again once the lock lifts.
Verify identity using the registered email and the business reference number.
If the caller needs urgent access, raise an unlock request after identity verification.
branches.tagging: Seller → Login & OTP → Account locked after failed login attempts
branches.description: For security, accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you get back in safely.

branches.agent_script: Password reset links expire after one hour and only the newest link works. Let's send a fresh one.
steps: Ask the caller to request a new reset link from the sign-in page.
Remind them to use only the most recent email, since earlier links are invalidated.
Ask them to open the link in a private browser window to avoid stale sessions.
If the new password is rejected, read out the password rules: 12+ characters with a number and a symbol.
Escalate if the reset page shows an error code.
documents: Screenshot of the error, if any
branches.tagging: Seller → Login & OTP → Password reset link not working
branches.description: Password reset links expire after one hour and only the newest link works. Let's send a fresh one.

branches.agent_script: You can update the registered address from the profile page; the change goes live after a quick document check.
steps: Ask the caller to open Profile > Business details > Address.
Have them enter the new address and upload a supporting address proof dated within the last three months.
Explain that open orders keep their original delivery address.
Tell the caller the compliance review takes up to two business days.
documents: Address proof dated within three months
branches.tagging: Seller → Profile & KYC → Update registered business address
branches.description: You can update the registered address from the profile page; the change goes live after a quick document check.

branches.agent_script: I'm sorry your KYC document was rejected. The rejection note usually tells us exactly what to fix.
steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection reason shown under Profile > Verification.
If the image was unclear, ask for a colour scan at 300 dpi or higher.
If the document has expired, ask them to upload a currently valid one.
If the name differs from the profile, align the profile name or upload a name-change document.
Escalate if the caller believes the rejection was made in error.
branches.tagging: Seller → Profile & KYC → KYC document rejected
branches.description: I'm sorry your KYC document was rejected. The rejection note usually tells us exactly what to fix.

branches.agent_script: Changing the authorised signatory needs a board or owner authorisation letter so we can protect your account.
steps: Confirm the caller is currently an admin on the seller account.
Ask them to upload an authorisation letter naming the new signatory.
Have the new signatory complete identity verification from their own login.
Explain that pending bids remain signed by the previous signatory.
documents: Identity proof of the new signatory
branches.tagging: Seller → Profile & KYC → Change authorised signatory
branches.description: Changing the authorised signatory needs a board or owner authorisation letter so we can protect your account.

branches.branch_name: Payout bank account could not be verified
branches.agent_script: Bank verification fails when the account holder name or routing code doesn't match bank records. Let's check them.
steps: Ask the caller to confirm the account holder name exactly as on the bank statement.
Verify the bank routing code and account number digit by digit.
Ask whether the account is a current account in the business's name; personal accounts are not accepted.
Have the caller re-run verification after correcting the details.
If it fails again, collect a cancelled cheque or bank letter and escalate.
documents: Cancelled cheque or bank confirmation letter
branches.tagging: Seller → Bank Account & Payouts → Payout bank account could not be verified
branches.description: Bank verification fails when the account holder name or routing code doesn't match bank records. Let's check them.

branches.agent_script: You can change the payout account at any time; payouts pause briefly while the new account is verified.
steps: Confirm the caller is the account admin.
Ask them to add the new account under Finance > Payout accounts.
Explain that a small test credit will verify the account within one business day.
Tell them to set the new account as primary once verified.
documents: Cancelled cheque for the new account
branches.tagging: Seller → Bank Account & Payouts → Change payout bank account
branches.description: You can change the payout account at any time; payouts pause briefly while the new account is verified.

branches.agent_script: Payouts are held when there's an open dispute, missing KYC, or an unverified bank account. Let me find which applies.
steps: Check the hold reason shown under Finance > Payouts.
If KYC is incomplete, guide the caller to finish verification.
If a dispute is open, explain that the related amount is released once the dispute closes.
If no reason is shown, escalate with the payout reference.
branches.tagging: Seller → Bank Account & Payouts → Payout on hold
branches.description: Payouts are held when there's an open dispute, missing KYC, or an unverified bank account. Let me find which applies.

branches.agent_script: New listings appear in search after quality review, usually within 24 hours. Let's confirm the listing status.
steps: Ask the caller to open Catalogue > My listings and read the status of the product.
If the status is 'In review', explain the 24-hour review window.
If the status is 'Inactive', ask them to check stock quantity and price validity dates.
If the status is 'Live' but not in search, ask them to search by the exact listing ID.
Escalate with the listing ID if it is live but still not searchable after 24 hours.
branches.tagging: Seller → Catalogue & Listings → Listing missing from buyer search
branches.description: New listings appear in search after quality review, usually within 24 hours. Let's confirm the listing status.

branches.agent_script: Listings are rejected when images, specifications or pricing don't meet catalogue rules. The rejection note lists the reason.
steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection note on the listing.
For image issues, ask for a plain white background and at least 800x800 pixels.
For specification issues, ensure mandatory attributes such as model and warranty are filled.
For pricing issues, confirm the price is within the allowed range for the category.
Ask the caller to edit and resubmit the listing.
branches.tagging: Seller → Catalogue & Listings → Listing rejected in quality check
branches.description: Listings are rejected when images, specifications or pricing don't meet catalogue rules. The rejection note lists the reason.

branches.agent_script: Bulk upload errors usually come from an outdated template or a few invalid rows. The error report pinpoints them.
steps: Ask the caller to download the latest template from Catalogue > Bulk upload.
Have them open the error report and fix the rows it lists.
Remind them not to rename columns or change the sheet order.
Ask them to upload no more than 500 rows per file.
branches.tagging: Seller → Catalogue & Listings → Bulk upload template errors
branches.description: Bulk upload errors usually come from an outdated template or a few invalid rows. The error report pinpoints them.

branches.agent_script: Brand approvals take up to five business days because we verify trademark ownership. Let's check the status.
steps: Note the brand request ID from the caller.
Check whether the request is waiting on a document from the seller.
If complete and under five business days, explain the timeline.
If over five business days, escalate with the brand request ID.
branches.tagging: Seller → Brand Authorisation → Brand approval pending
branches.description: Brand approvals take up to five business days because we verify trademark ownership. Let's check the status.

branches.agent_script: To sell another company's brand, we need a valid authorisation letter from the brand owner. Let's see why it was rejected.
steps: Ask the caller to read the rejection reason.
Confirm the letter is on the brand owner's letterhead and signed.
Check the letter names the seller's legal business name and has a validity date.
Ask the caller to upload the corrected letter.
documents: Signed authorisation letter from the brand owner
branches.tagging: Seller → Brand Authorisation → Reseller authorisation letter rejected
branches.description: To sell another company's brand, we need a valid authorisation letter from the brand owner. Let's see why it was rejected.

branches.branch_name: Add a new brand to the catalogue
branches.agent_script: If your brand isn't in the dropdown, you can request it. Once approved, it becomes available for your listings.
steps: Ask the caller to search the brand list once more with alternate spellings.
Guide them to Catalogue > Brands > Request new brand.
Have them attach the trademark certificate or brand ownership proof.
Explain the five-business-day review timeline.
documents: Trademark certificate or brand ownership proof
branches.tagging: Seller → Brand Authorisation → Add a new brand to the catalogue
branches.description: If your brand isn't in the dropdown, you can request it. Once approved, it becomes available for your listings.

branches.branch_name: Unable to submit bid before deadline
branches.agent_script: Bid submission blocks when a mandatory document or declaration is missing. Let's find what's pending before the deadline.
steps: Note the bid number and the submission deadline.
Ask the caller to open the bid checklist and read any items marked incomplete.
Confirm all mandatory documents are PDF files under 10 MB each.
Ask them to accept the declarations on the final page.
If the deadline is within one hour and the button is still disabled, escalate immediately.
branches.tagging: Seller → Bids & Reverse Auctions → Unable to submit bid before deadline
branches.description: Bid submission blocks when a mandatory document or declaration is missing. Let's find what's pending before the deadline.

branches.branch_name: Reverse auction not visible to seller
branches.agent_script: Only sellers who qualified in the technical round are invited to the reverse auction. Let me check your status.
steps: Note the bid number linked to the auction.
Check whether the seller qualified in the technical evaluation.
If qualified, ask the caller to check Bids > Auctions and refresh after the start time.
If not qualified, explain the evaluation result and where to view remarks.
branches.tagging: Seller → Bids & Reverse Auctions → Reverse auction not visible to seller
branches.description: Only sellers who qualified in the technical round are invited to the reverse auction. Let me check your status.

branches.agent_script: I'm sorry your bid was disqualified. The evaluation remarks explain why, and you may be able to raise a representation.
steps: Ask the caller to open the bid and read the evaluation remarks.
Explain that representations can be raised within 48 hours of the result.
Guide them to Bids > Representation and attach supporting documents.
Set expectations that the buyer reviews representations, not the support team.
branches.tagging: Seller → Bids & Reverse Auctions → Bid disqualified in technical evaluation
branches.description: I'm sorry your bid was disqualified. The evaluation remarks explain why, and you may be able to raise a representation.

branches.branch_name: Order not appearing in seller dashboard
branches.agent_script: Orders appear in the dashboard within 15 minutes of the buyer confirming. Let's find yours.
steps: Ask for the order number the buyer shared.
Ask the caller to search by order number under Orders > All orders.
Check that the date filter includes the order date.
If a sub-user is logged in, confirm they have order access.
Escalate with the order number if it still doesn't appear.
branches.tagging: Seller → Orders & Delivery → Order not appearing in seller dashboard
branches.description: Orders appear in the dashboard within 15 minutes of the buyer confirming. Let's find yours.

branches.agent_script: You can request a delivery extension from the order page; the buyer approves or rejects it.
steps: Ask the caller to open the order and choose 'Request extension'.
Have them enter a new date and a clear reason.
Explain that late delivery penalties may apply if the buyer rejects the request.
Advise them to request the extension before the original date passes.
branches.tagging: Seller → Orders & Delivery → Request delivery date extension
branches.description: You can request a delivery extension from the order page; the buyer approves or rejects it.

branches.agent_script: Buyers can cancel before dispatch. If you had already shipped, we can help you raise a claim.
steps: Check whether the order was cancelled before or after dispatch.
If before dispatch, explain no further action is needed.
If after dispatch, ask for the shipment tracking number.
Guide the caller to raise a cancellation claim with the tracking proof.
branches.tagging: Seller → Orders & Delivery → Order cancelled by buyer
branches.description: Buyers can cancel before dispatch. If you had already shipped, we can help you raise a claim.

branches.agent_script: Invoices can only be generated after the buyer confirms receipt. Let's check the order status.
steps: Ask for the order number.
Check whether the buyer has generated the goods receipt.
If not, explain that the invoice unlocks after receipt confirmation.
If receipt is confirmed, ask the caller to retry and note any error code.
Escalate with the error code if generation still fails.
branches.tagging: Seller → Invoices & Payments → Invoice generation failed
branches.description: Invoices can only be generated after the buyer confirms receipt. Let's check the order status.

branches.agent_script: Buyers have 10 days after receipt to pay. Let me check where the payment is in that cycle.
steps: Ask for the order number and invoice date.
Check whether the buyer has confirmed receipt and approved the invoice.
If within 10 days of receipt, explain the payment timeline.
If overdue, raise a payment follow-up to the buyer organisation.
Escalate if the follow-up is unanswered after three business days.
branches.tagging: Seller → Invoices & Payments → Payment delayed after delivery
branches.description: Buyers have 10 days after receipt to pay. Let me check where the payment is in that cycle.

branches.agent_script: Tax is calculated from the product's tax category at order time. Let's compare that with your invoice.
steps: Ask for the order number and the tax rate the caller expected.
Check the tax category saved on the listing at order time.
If the listing category was wrong, guide the caller to issue a credit note and corrected invoice.
Remind them to fix the listing so future orders are correct.
branches.tagging: Seller → Invoices & Payments → Tax amount mismatch on invoice
branches.description: Tax is calculated from the product's tax category at order time. Let's compare that with your invoice.

branches.agent_script: Missed pickups happen when the courier slot was full. We can rebook it and protect your dispatch date.
steps: Ask for the order number and the pickup slot that was booked.
Check the courier's pickup status and any 'attempted' note.
Rebook the pickup for the next available slot from the shipment page.
If the dispatch deadline is today, mark the order 'pickup delayed by courier' so no penalty applies.
Escalate if the courier misses the rebooked slot.
branches.tagging: Seller → Shipping & Logistics → Courier missed the scheduled pickup
branches.description: Missed pickups happen when the courier slot was full. We can rebook it and protect your dispatch date.

branches.agent_script: Labels fail when the package weight or dimensions are missing. Let's check the shipment form.
steps: Ask the caller to open the shipment form for the order.
Confirm package weight and all three dimensions are filled in.
Check that the pickup address has a valid postcode.
Ask them to regenerate the label and download the PDF.
branches.tagging: Seller → Shipping & Logistics → Shipping label will not generate
branches.description: Labels fail when the package weight or dimensions are missing. Let's check the shipment form.

branches.branch_name: Courier says delivery address is undeliverable
branches.agent_script: When the courier can't find the address, we confirm it with the buyer before the parcel is sent back.
steps: Ask for the order number and the courier's failure reason.
Contact the buyer's consignee through the order messages to confirm the address and a phone number.
Share the corrected details with the courier from the shipment page.
If the buyer doesn't reply in 48 hours, let the shipment return and inform the buyer.
branches.tagging: Seller → Shipping & Logistics → Courier says delivery address is undeliverable
branches.description: When the courier can't find the address, we confirm it with the buyer before the parcel is sent back.

branches.branch_name: Add a sub-user to seller account
branches.agent_script: Admins can add sub-users and give them limited roles, so your team can work without sharing passwords.
steps: Confirm the caller is the account admin.
Guide them to Settings > Users > Add user.
Have them choose a role such as Catalogue, Bids or Finance.
Explain that the new user receives an activation email.
branches.tagging: Seller → Sub-users & Roles → Add a sub-user to seller account
branches.description: Admins can add sub-users and give them limited roles, so your team can work without sharing passwords.

branches.agent_script: When a sub-user can't see a section, it's almost always their role. The admin can adjust it.
steps: Ask which section the sub-user cannot open.
Ask the admin to open Settings > Users and check that user's role.
Add the Bids permission or change the role.
Ask the sub-user to sign out and back in.
branches.tagging: Seller → Sub-users & Roles → Sub-user cannot access bids
branches.description: When a sub-user can't see a section, it's almost always their role. The admin can adjust it.

branches.branch_name: Transfer admin role to another user
branches.agent_script: Transferring admin rights protects your account when people change roles. It needs confirmation from the business.
steps: If the current admin is available, they can transfer the role from Settings > Users.
If the admin has left, collect an authorisation letter from the business.
The new admin must complete identity verification.
Escalate letter-based transfers for manual approval.
documents: Identity proof of the new admin
branches.tagging: Seller → Sub-users & Roles → Transfer admin role to another user
branches.description: Transferring admin rights protects your account when people change roles. It needs confirmation from the business.

branches.agent_script: When a buyer raises a quality dispute, you get seven days to respond with evidence.
steps: Ask for the dispute ID.
Explain the seven-day response window.
Guide the caller to respond with photos, test reports or replacement offers.
Explain that the dispute cell decides if both sides cannot agree.
branches.tagging: Seller → Disputes & Returns → Buyer raised a quality dispute
branches.description: When a buyer raises a quality dispute, you get seven days to respond with evidence.

branches.agent_script: Return pickups are scheduled by the seller within three days of the return being approved.
steps: Ask for the return ID.
Check whether the return was approved.
Guide the seller to schedule pickup from the return page.
If the courier missed the pickup, ask them to reschedule and share the courier reference.
branches.tagging: Seller → Disputes & Returns → Return pickup not scheduled
branches.description: Return pickups are scheduled by the seller within three days of the return being approved.

branches.agent_script: Penalties are applied automatically for late delivery. If the delay wasn't yours, you can request a waiver.
steps: Ask for the order number and the penalty amount.
Check whether an extension was approved for the order.
If an approved extension exists, raise a waiver request with the approval reference.
If the buyer caused the delay, collect evidence and raise a waiver request.
branches.tagging: Seller → Disputes & Returns → Penalty applied incorrectly
branches.description: Penalties are applied automatically for late delivery. If the delay wasn't yours, you can request a waiver.
